title: WordPress application password stops working with no warning
symptoms: {"code":"incorrect_password","message":"The provided password is an invalid application password."}
Every authenticated write fails at once
cause: Application passwords can be revoked with no notice to integrations. incorrect_password means the user exists and the password is dead; invalid_username means the login name is wrong. A new application password cannot be minted through the API without a working credential.
fix: Read the error code to tell the two apart. Regenerate the password in the user's profile while logged in, and store it where every integration reads from.
apply: wp-admin > Users > Profile > Application Passwords > enter a name > Add New Application Password
